title: Financial Advisor NLU Dataset Record Schema
description: Authoritative machine-readable contract for every record in the Financial Advisor NLU training dataset. Enforces the canonical slot taxonomy, intent taxonomy, null-safety invariants, and enum constraints established in Step 8A/8B. Language scope: English only (Phase 1).

example_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this dataset example. Format: EN_<FAMILY>_<NNNN>.

template_id.description: Identifier of the controlled template that generated this example. All examples sharing the same template_id must reside in the same train/val/test split to prevent data leakage.

template_family.description: The template family category (one of the 8 canonical families).

language.description: Language of the input text. Phase 1 is English only.

split.description: Dataset partition. Must be assigned at the template_id level, not the example level.

input_text.description: The raw natural-language English utterance from the user.

intent.description: The canonical intent classification label for this utterance.

slots.description: Canonical slot dictionary. All 7 keys MUST be present. Missing information MUST be null, never omitted.

monthly_income.description: Monthly income in USD as a non-negative number, or null if not stated. Unknown != 0.

monthly_expense.description: Monthly expense in USD as a non-negative number, or null if not stated. Unknown != 0.

employment_status.description: Employment status. Must match ConsultantValidator canonical values.

debt_status.description: Debt status. Must match ConsultantValidator canonical values.

spending_habit.description: Spending habit tier. Must match ConsultantValidator canonical values.

goal_cost.description: Financial goal cost in USD as a non-negative number, or null if not stated.

marital_status.description: Marital status. Must match ConsultantValidator canonical values (capitalized).

slot_spans.description: Character-level span annotations for slots that have explicit textual evidence. Python-style: start=inclusive, end=exclusive. Not required for null slots.

start.description: Inclusive start character offset in input_text.

end.description: Exclusive end character offset in input_text.

value.description: The canonically extracted value for this span.

expected_rule_id.description: The canonical rule ID that ConsultantEngine would select given these slots, or null if slots are insufficient or intent is out-of-scope. Must be computed by the engine, never manually invented.

validation_status.description: Result of automated validation checks against this record.

source_type.description: Provenance of how this example was generated.

concept_source.description: Conceptual provenance tag. Use 'original' for examples not derived from any PDF reference. Use CFA_* or WILEY_* tags for concept-inspired examples. No verbatim text is ever copied.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for auditing and analysis.
